g.title: timeline
g.text: Initial restorable user-message checkpoint; no files tracked yet.
First real prompt checkpoint; no file-history-aware writes yet.
Checkpoint before the turn that creates the design spec.
Write created a new spec file. Null means the pre-write state was "file did not exist".
Next checkpoint captures the existing spec file contents as the first physical backup blob.
Write created a new plan file and updates the latest base snapshot.
Next checkpoint captures the existing plan file contents as a physical backup blob.
Later checkpoint reuses unchanged backup metadata.
Later checkpoint reuses unchanged backup metadata.
Later checkpoint reuses unchanged backup metadata.
Latest observed checkpoint reuses unchanged backup metadata.

g.title: legend
g.text: No physical blob. The file did not exist at the captured pre-write state.
For base snapshots, top-level messageId and snapshot.messageId point to the same user message.
